notes.title: BIG UPDATE v.2.2
notes.content:
[b]BIG UPDATE[/b]

Good news, everyone! Now we are working on adding achievements, it will take some time due to the specifics of the engine limitations.

[b]This patch has made significant game core changes:[/b]

• Redesign of all levels for better performance/balance
• 2 New Levels
• New Soundtracks
• Rebalanced enemies damage
• New super fast animations for weapons
• Improved lighting
• Performance tweaks

IMPORTANT NOTES – WORK IN PROGRESS:
• Because of the redesign/rebalance you can lost your progress. If you run into any issues please email me at madboxgamestudio@gmail.com 

• To make sure that all files are downloaded, update the game manually. You can do this by followign the instructions below:

1. Load Steam
2. From the Library section, right-click on the game and select "Properties" from the menu.
3. Select the "Local Files" tab and click the "Verify integrity of game cache..." button.
4. Steam will verify the game's files - this process may take several minutes.
5. Once the process is completed, the window will automatically exit, and you will be ready for action.

Thanks again for your support! And continue emailing the issues you run into, it helps a lot!
